one_line: Jensen Huang returned as Nvidia CEO, OpenAI and Anthropic released research and model updates, and Amazon acquired Decart for $7.5 billion.

themes.title: New research and model capabilities released
themes.text: OpenAI announced GPT-6 protein-design capabilities, an Anthropic mathematician announced an AI-assisted proof of the Riemann hypothesis, OpenAI published a preprint on the matrix multiplication exponent, and the OpenClaw Foundation introduced the ShellBench benchmark.

stories.headline: Anthropic mathematician announces AI-assisted proof of Riemann hypothesis
OpenAI preprint claims matrix multiplication exponent is exactly 9/4
OpenClaw Foundation launches ShellBench benchmark; top AI agents complete only about 60% of real-world tasks

themes.title: Nvidia leadership changes and government involvement
themes.text: Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia CEO following lobbying by President Donald Trump and Silicon Huang allies, and apologized for code of conduct violations. Trump stated a pardon is an option and noted the US government may acquire a stake in Nvidia.

stories.headline: Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO after intervention by Trump and tech allies
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang apologizes for code of conduct violations at first all-hands since return
Trump says pardon for Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang is 'always an option'
US government may acquire stake in Nvidia, says Trump

themes.title: Tech industry acquisitions and stock movements
themes.text: Amazon agreed to acquire Decart's optimization technology for $7.5 billion, Anthropic shares fell below their $83 IPO price, and Asian tech stocks declined following a US tech sell-off.

stories.headline: Amazon acquires Decart optimization tech for $7.5 billion to boost Trainium chips
Anthropic shares fall below $83 IPO price after record debut
Asian tech stocks tumble following US tech sell-off
